title: Mode-less counter-metered pump: an unplanned hot-water charge folds into the house learner as space heat
claim: On a plant with an electric and a heat counter (heat meter declared to see DHW), a DHW tank thermometer and no operating-mode entity, a heat-counter span holding a 3.75 kWh hot-water charge the plan had not scheduled is read as 4.54 kW of space heat against 0.79 kW true and folds into a fabric learner (1 of 3 charge-holding spans); with the mode select mapped, or with the pump following the plan, the count is 0.
mechanism: With no mode entity the ModeDwell observes nothing, so heat_energy.attribution falls back to the plan's split and space_heat_kw applies the whole-unit rule (the whole span is space heat when the plan put no DHW in it); the configured tank thermometer, which rose 4 K per charging cycle, is not consulted, so the charge reaches close_span's interval and the house/lower learners.

evidence.unit: closed heat-counter spans (of 7; 3 hold a real charge) whose space figure exceeds the plant's true space heat by >0.05 kW and that fold into a fabric learner (RESULT inflated_spans_folded)
evidence.machine: box B6, Linux x86_64, python 3.14.7, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats on B6 (load1 4-11); a count, contention-immune
evidence.tolerance: exact (clock frozen per cycle; prices laid from the start hour -- the span's index can shift with the start hour, the count held on 3 runs)

instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.heat_energy:close_span (span_heat / space_heat_kw on the evidence heatpump_optimizer.coordinator:HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._async_update_data folds)

perturbation.change: --perturb unobserved-no-space: heat_energy.space_heat_kw returns None for an integrated span the dwell did not observe (one-line production edit)

metric_definition: Closed heat-counter spans holding a real DHW charge whose space figure exceeds true space heat/hours by >0.05 kW and that reach the house or lower learner.
phenomenon_property: A heat-counter span that held a hot-water charge never reaches a space-heat learner as space heat, whether the charge was observed through a mode entity or only through the configured tank thermometer.

null_control.command: counter_spans.py --sees-dhw (mode select mapped); counter_spans.py --sees-dhw --no-mode --plan-only (pump follows the plan)
null_control.value: 0 and 0 inflated spans (2 charge-holding spans each)
null_control.note: The same plant with the mode entity mapped subtracts the charge exactly (bad_spans=0); with the pump following the plan the whole-unit rule holds. The defect is the mode-less cell.

reproduction_steps: counter_spans.py --sees-dhw --no-mode: INFLATED span ... space 4.540 kW vs true 0.789 kW; RESULT inflated_spans_folded=1
proposed_fix_scope: heat_energy / the span's evidence: on an unobserved span, treat a configured tank thermometer's rise as a hot-water charge (refuse the span's space figure), rather than trusting the plan split alone
